mondrian.title: BLOCK / BORDER / BLOCK
mondrian.body: A gallery study after Mondrian: primary colours separated by thin black levels.

albers.title: WARMTH IN STEPS
albers.body: The Albers gallery study: four diminishing blocks, four warm colours. A stacked adaptation, not the painting.

memphis.title: COLOUR TAKES LIBERTIES
memphis.body: The Memphis gallery study: yellow, red, teal and pink interrupted by dark and pale bands.

bauhaus_tall.title: EIGHT PIECES / ONE COLUMN
bauhaus_tall.body: The tall Bauhaus gallery stack: different primitives and proportions read upward as one construction.

blue.title: A FAMILY OF BLUES
blue.body: The Klein gallery study uses two blue values across angular and round forms. Follow the contour as you walk.

kras_rainbow.title: THE RAINBOW BECOMES A COLUMN
kras_rainbow.body: A table-sized study, 72 centimetres tall, raised to 6.2 metres. Thirty fixed stripes carry six colours around the shaft.

rainbow_crown.title: RAINBOW / CROWN
rainbow_crown.body: The rainbow pedestal carries the eight-piece Bauhaus stack: two gallery configurations become one 7.2 m column.

memphis_beacon.title: MEMPHIS / STRIPES / BEADS
memphis_beacon.body: Memphis blocks carry a striped shaft and a red-bead crown. Three gallery configurations, one 7.4 m stack.
